question: Has the collective discussed Diginex's path to profitability given the M&A spend?

beat.line: Diginex's profitability hinges on a classic merger problem: near-term margin squeeze, longer-term operating leverage.
beat.headline: INTEGRATION TAX
beat.action: The document splits into two torn arrows, one bending down, one climbing right.

sources: Diginex's profitability trajectory hinges on a classic M&A math problem: near-term margin compression from integration costs, offset by longer-term operating leverage as the unified platform scales.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: soft violet. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: the open document; two torn-paper arrows.
Opens on the open document, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The document splits into two torn arrows, one bending down, one climbing right.
Ends holding on the crossed arrows.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "INTEGRATION TAX".

COPY LIST: "INTEGRATION TAX". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Diginex's profitability hinges on a classic merger problem: near-term margin squeeze, longer-term operating leverage.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D-animated, modern editorial paper collage with a refined motion design style. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, which features a flat, soft violet background. In the center is a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a person's face and an open document, both featuring rough white torn-paper edges and small shadows cast from a consistent upper-left light source. Several pieces of matte translucent tape hold the elements in place. Immediately on the first frame, the image transforms: the photographic cutout of the person and the existing "OUTSIDE SOURCES" text disappear instantly. The remaining open document cutout splits apart with a fast, snappy motion and a slight overshoot, transforming into two distinct, flat matte paper arrows. One arrow, colored in cream with a rough white torn edge, bends sharply downward; the other arrow, colored in black with a rough white torn edge, climbs toward the right. Simultaneously, a rectangular cream paper chip with a rough torn edge slides into the upper portion of the frame, bearing the headline "INTEGRATION TAX" in an extra-bold, black sans-serif typeface. The text is clean, legible, and stable. The narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Diginex's profitability hinges on a classic merger problem: near-term margin squeeze, longer-term operating leverage.</d> The camera remains a Static Shot throughout the 5 seconds. The animation concludes with the two crossed arrows and the headline holding in a clear reading window, with a very subtle, slow looping pulse in the position of the arrows to maintain visual energy.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice. Beneath the speech, tactile foley sounds occur: a crisp, rhythmic paper-slap as the document splits and the arrows appear, and a short, sticky peeling sound as the text chip slides into place.
